tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background (also the PWA background_color). Body text `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: disabled time slots, segmented-control track, empty states. `ink` and `ink-muted` read on it.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs and sheets raised above `surface-100`. `ink`, `ink-muted` and `danger` read on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `surface-100`, `surface-200`, `surface-card`, `brand-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints and captions on `surface-100`, `surface-200`, `surface-card`. Never on `brand` or `accent` fills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card outlines. Not for control borders (use `border-strong`).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and secondary buttons (3:1 on `surface-card` and `surface-100`).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Soft sky blue. Fill for primary buttons, selected time slot and the language toggle. Text on it uses `on-brand`. Not for text on sand (use `brand-text`).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand` fills.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Blue as text: links and ghost buttons on `surface-100`, `surface-card` and `surface-200`.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind confirmed badges and selected rows. `ink` reads on it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Warm clay, a fill only: highlights, dots, today marker. Text on it uses `on-accent`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Background of pending badges. `accent-text` reads on it.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Clay as text: pending status on `accent-soft`, and on `surface-100`/`surface-card`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, destructive button fill and declined status on `surface-100`, `surface-card`, `danger-soft`. Text on a danger fill uses `on-danger`.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on `danger` fills.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of declined badges and error banners. `danger` reads on it.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 3px solid with 2px offset, 3:1 or better on `surface-100`, `surface-card` and `surface-200`.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Home hero and confirmation headline, one per screen.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default copy and input text. 16px minimum stops iOS zooming on focus.
styles.sample: We will confirm your request by phone.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips and inline items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between time slots; field label to input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on phones; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of hero blocks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small chips inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, time slots.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, badges, segmented control.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Cards on `surface-100`. Flat in dark theme comes from the `line` outline.

touch.note: Minimum interactive size for fingers; the admin works from a phone.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Min height of buttons, inputs and time slots.
